thread:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: release v2.3.1 -> prod. Change window 23:00-23:30 UTC. Canary 10% now. Running post-deploy smoke suite (healthchecks + synthetic-kv-probe). Release notes: https://redwood.example.com/releases/v2.3.1 :rocket:

sam: copy. i'll watch the synthetic dashboard, ping if anything weird.

maria: noted. quick reminder: this build pins kernel 4.1.2 for the quantized path. file:///releases/v2.3.1/notes has the details.

kevin: seeing first synthetic run success on general healthchecks (api root, liveness). kv-probe failed on node-a with 503s, reproducing locally against staging image. logs: ```ERROR kv lookup timeout (2000ms)```. 

lucy: @kevin can you paste the failing curl? also what percent is the canary at?

kevin: curl -s -D - -o /dev/null "https://prod-kv.redwood/api/v1/kv/test?key=smoke" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN"
response: HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable

sam: thanks. rolling back the canary from 10% -> 2% for now, leaving the deployment object in-place. will keep the rest of the fleet on previous version until root cause known.

maria: suggestion: pin model routing for the impacted service to v2.3.0 to avoid hitting the quantized kernel path while we debug. We can do traffic-split override in routing-config: ```traffic: product-kv: - weight: 98 version: v2.3.0 - weight: 2 version: v2.3.1```

deploy-bot: Canary adjusted to 2%. Routing override applied to product-kv. Notifying oncall.

oncall-bot: @oncall paging: KV 503 spike detected during post-deploy smoke. Incident channel created: #incidents/kv-smoke-1778023345.

lucy: running a targeted synthetic with increased retries against node-a to rule out transient connection errors. If kv backend is overloaded by cache warmup, we should see retry success.

kevin: retry confirms same 503 after retries. digging into kernel selection logs on node-a, there is a mismatch for quantized kernels, failing to allocate temp buffers. stack excerpt: ```kernel_select: quant_opt fail -> OOM temp_buf```

sam: decision: hold rollout. Pin routing to v2.3.0 until a patch is cut. I'll update release notes and the changelog to reflect the rollback/pin decision and schedule a patch for tomorrow's change window.

maria: +1. action items: (1) kevin to open a bug with kernel logs + node dump, (2) lucy to run a focused repro with different CPU affinity, (3) sam to update release notes & submit rollback-runbook tweak.

kevin: bug filed: LINK: https://redwood.example.com/bugs/INC-4821 — attached kernel logs and heap profiles.

lucy: ran repro with affinity=2 and it temporarily avoided the failure; looks like allocator fragmentation. adding allocator tuning to next patch.

sam: updated release notes and pinned the release entry: "v2.3.1: rollout paused; routing pinned to v2.3.0 for product-kv due to quant kernel allocation failures during smoke tests." Added rollback instructions and expected timeline.

oncall-bot: Synthetic smoke checks cleared at 23:12 UTC after pin. Monitoring for 30m.

sam: thanks everyone. keeping this thread for postmortem notes. will reopen rollout after a validated patch and clean smoke results across nodes. :white_check_mark:
